title: LLM wiki page frontmatter: OKF v0.2 profile + memoryfield identity + iirc evidence
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of one wiki page. OKF v0.2 keys keep OKF meaning; memoryfield/iirc keys keep theirs; keys marked 'profile' are additions of this design. Unknown keys are allowed, as OKF requires consumers to tolerate them.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 with explicit offset (OKF §5). Quote it in YAML so it stays a string.

actor.description: OKF actor convention: <producer>/<version>, human:<id>, process:<id>; profile adds agent:<harness>@<host>#<session>.

type.description: OKF (required there, free text). Profile closes the vocabulary.

summary.description: memoryfield/iirc. One or two sentences an agent can judge relevance from. Mirror into OKF 'description'.

uuid.description: memoryfield. Never changes on edit or rename; a split gets new uuids; a merge records merged_from.

aliases.description: Obsidian. Also SKOS altLabel for Topic pages.

topics.description: profile. Slugs of Topic pages (SKOS concepts). Most specific topic per facet; hubs roll up 'broader'.

scope.description: profile. Which space the page lives in and who it concerns.

status.description: OKF lifecycle. Writers may set draft only; the librarian promotes to stable.

conditions.description: memoryfield status vocabulary, moved here to avoid colliding with OKF status.

generated.description: OKF. Who produced the current text.

verified.description: OKF list; trust tier is derived from it. Server clears it on any content edit. Profile adds rev (git blob the check covered) and method.

stale_after.description: OKF. Set from volatility unless given.

volatility.description: profile. Sets default stale_after; evidence events mark suspect regardless.

applies_to.description: profile. Version ranges a lint job compares against release feeds, e.g. {python: '>=3.12', uv: '>=0.5,<0.6'}.

as_of.description: profile (Wikipedia {{as of}}). Date the page's time-sensitive claims describe.

check.description: iirc. Read-only shell command; non-zero exit marks the page suspect. Runs only after approval.

resource.description: OKF. The thing this concept is bound to (Source pages: the original URL).

redirect.description: profile. Only on type: Redirect stubs left by renames/merges.

promote_to.description: profile. Working notes: pages a finding should be proposed into.

sources.description: OKF provenance. Profile adds iirc revision, Wikipedia retrieved/archive/url_status, a content hash, a W3C TextQuoteSelector quote, and a registry tier.

usage_count.description: OKF. Ignored for trust in this profile (frequency is exploitable).

revision.description: iirc file@sha: git commit the cited file was read at.

hash.description: Hash of the normalized source text when read; drift job re-hashes.
